annotations.title: Suggest matches for sevDesk bank transactions

description: Bank reconciliation (Kontoabgleich, Zuordnung): for unassigned bank transactions (Kontoumsätze, status created, or partly linked with a rest), rank the open invoices (Rechnungen), credit notes (Gutschriften) and vouchers (Belege, by Belegnummer) they most likely pay: exact open amount, document number in the purpose (Verwendungszweck), counterparty name, date; plus split suggestions (several documents adding up exactly). Each match has reasons, a confidence and the exact sevdesk_transaction_book call; book only after the user agrees. Call it directly: without arguments it scans the unassigned transactions of every bank account; pass transactionId, or checkAccountId and/or a value-date range to narrow it (page with offset). Imported bank accounts only: offline and cash accounts get their transactions from bookings. Read-only.

from.description: First day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

offset.description: sevDesk transaction rows to skip: pass nextOffset from the previous call.

to.description: Last day to include, YYYY-MM-DD (Berlin time).

transactionId.description: One transaction (Umsatz) id; leave out to scan unassigned ones.

name: sevdesk_reconcile_suggest
